card.name: Words just before glucose tolerance
card.fires_on: Words right before 'glucose' in phrases like 'decrease glucose tolerance', plus the word glucose itself. Also number signs in fasting glucose cutoffs and 'and' after Insulin.

modes.label: Decrease glucose tolerance
modes.description: The verb, 'in', or 'glucose' in warnings that hormones may lower glucose tolerance.

modes.label: Glucose cutoff values
modes.description: The ≥ sign in fasting glucose ranges such as 100 and <126.

modes.description: Linking word after Insulin in lists of diabetes drugs.

card.plain: It fires when the text is about to talk about glucose or insulin, as in hormone warnings about glucose tolerance.
